_about: By-eye ratings of the engineering suite, 1-10 per task. Rated by Claude from the saved pictures (software renderer): the watch screenshot, and the rocket at liftoff (plume_t2.png), at 4 s (smoke_t4.png) and above 100 km (karman.png). 0 = no picture. Edit freely; make_summary.py and make_top10.py read this file. Keys are run folder names.
